plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Persistent private Chrome automation for linked accounts with accessibility-first typed actions, bounded live streaming, exclusive user takeover and a deny-by-default enforcing network boundary.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: codebase
plugins.description: Semantic code index: search your repositories by MEANING, not literal text. Chunks each accessible repo, embeds every chunk with the SAME embedding model your memory uses (Settings → Memory), and stores the vectors in a private per-repo index. CodebaseSearch finds the most relevant code/docs for a natural-language query; CodebaseReindex refreshes it incrementally; CodebaseStatus reports coverage. Complements the files plugin's literal Search.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: cronjob
plugins.description: Scheduler: recurring prompts, one-shot wake-ups and shell collectors that wake the agent on a schedule, with a jobs screen in Settings.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Discord bot: chat with Elowen in a server channel, thread or DM, with slash commands, live message editing and role-based admission; account permissions come from the linked Elowen account.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: editor
plugins.description: Project file editor with Monaco, file management, previews for Markdown, images, PDF, media, Office and CSV files, a binary download fallback, and read-only Git history. Disabling it removes the editor UI and makes its grandfathered project-file API unavailable while project registration and task Git history remain available.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Account-scoped GitHub CLI device authentication for repository mappings, secure Sandbox branch publishing, pull requests, reviews, checks and explicitly confirmed merges.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: image-edit
plugins.description: Edit an existing image from a text instruction (image-to-image) via the OpenAI Images edits API. The result shows in the chat.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: image-gen
plugins.description: Image generation via the OpenAI Images API (gpt-image-1 by default). Generated images show directly in the chat.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: lsp
plugins.description: Language-server code intelligence: type-check an edit the moment it lands (LspDiagnostics), jump to a definition, find every reference, read a hover signature and list document or workspace symbols — all answered by the real language server for the file, not a text search. Elowen drives the servers it knows (TypeScript, Pyright, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, …) and can install the npm-based ones into its own prefix. Disabling it stops every language server and withdraws the tools.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: mcp
plugins.description: Connect external MCP servers to the assistant’s tools.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: msteams
plugins.description: Microsoft Teams bot with delegated Entra account linking, a compact Microsoft 365 Graph tool suite, proactive messaging, file consent, Adaptive Cards and a clear identity workspace.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: onedrive
plugins.description: Mirrors a Project between the daemon and each person's own OneDrive in both directions, so files the agent produces appear in their OneDrive without being handed over in chat.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Loads markdown skills from disk and exposes them to the Elowen brain.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: sites
plugins.description: Publish a web page the agent built - a dashboard, a report, a landing page - at a real address on this instance, and decide who may open it: only you, the Project's people, any signed-in account, named guests, or everyone. The agent builds with its own toolchain and hands over the finished output; every publish is a separate release you can roll back to.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: stats
plugins.description: Model usage analytics for tokens, cost, cache efficiency and generation speed. Uses Elowen's shared usage ledger and keeps task tracking focused on work rather than infrastructure spend.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram bot: chat with Elowen in a private chat, group or forum topic, with slash commands, inline keyboards and live message editing.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Session task list: the agent tracks multi-step work incrementally and shows progress live.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: voice-bot
plugins.description: Outbound telephone calls: the agent dials a real phone number through a configurable voice API and briefs the voice agent that speaks on the call.
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web research: WebSearch (Tavily) and WebFetch (fetch a page as readable text).
plugins.author: Elowen

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp bot over a paired phone: chat with Elowen from any WhatsApp conversation, with slash commands, numbered menus and a QR pairing screen in Settings.
plugins.author: Elowen
